insights.summary: FY26 revenue rose 33% to ₹1,339 Cr, with EBITDA doubling to ₹480 Cr (35.9% margin) and record PAT of ₹356 Cr; Q4 alone had a 42.4% EBITDA margin on the CDMO (darolutamide intermediate) ramp-up. Management guided 25% revenue growth for FY27 with margins similar to FY26, and repeated ₹1,000 Cr of CDMO revenue by FY28. Battery-chemical additives (VC, FEC) started production, and the Korean semiconductor JV Indichem got ₹190 Cr of investment.

what_changed.text: EBITDA margin in FY27 similar to FY26 (not Q4's 42%)
Pilot plant pushed to Q2 FY27 because equipment arrived late
10x larger R&D centre and land purchase planned; capex not yet finalised

tone.label: confident
tone.quote:
I'm confident of
delivering 25% revenue growth in FY '27.

analyst_questions.answer: 25% of the ₹190 Cr investment went to goodwill because the Korean partner got 25% equity at par; management says it is recoverable.
25% is the long-run CAGR; it would be revised up later in the year if the business runs ahead.
A 'meaningful' contribution ramping from Q1 to Q4; capacity of 2,000 t each of VC and FEC is contracted for three years. No number given.
Q4 EBITDA margin about 44% in pharma intermediates and 29% in specialty chemicals (helped by BFC recovery).

red_flags.text: Growth depends heavily on one CDMO anchor product (darolutamide intermediate for Fermion/Bayer).
₹48 Cr of goodwill booked on the new Korean JV, which has no revenue yet.
Gulf conflict pushed raw material prices up and disrupted shipping.
Working capital rose to 120 days from 114.

watch_next: FY27 revenue growth tracking 25%, with H1 about 40% of the year
EBITDA margin staying near 36% as battery chemicals (lower margin) ramp up
Revenue from the four validated CDMO products
Indichem plant completion in H2 CY26

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Advanced pharma intermediates and CDMO (~87% of FY26 revenue); specialty chemicals including battery electrolyte additives (VC, FEC) and semiconductor chemicals via Baba Fine Chemicals
business_snapshot.customers: 600+ customers, global innovators and generic makers (Fermion/Orion for the anchor CDMO product), Heraeus for BFC, battery-cell makers in North America and Korea
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: Pharma intermediates ₹392 Cr and specialty chemicals ₹40 Cr in Q4 FY26
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Ramp-up of the darolutamide (Nubeqa) intermediate, new CDMO molecules, EV battery demand, memory-chip demand
